name: lastwave-addon-service
description: LastWave Addons — per-account addon service with Telegram/Discord verification, 500 songs/day quota, and admin console.

scripts.verify: node tools/build-css.js && node tools/build-js.js && node -e "for (const f of ['src/index.js','src/html.js','src/ui/esc.js','src/ui/icons.js','src/ui/layout.js','src/ui/components.js','src/views/home.js','src/views/auth.js','src/views/dashboard.js','src/routes/web.js','src/routes/verify.js','src/routes/admin.js','src/routes/addon.js','src/routes/github.js','src/routes/password.js','public/app.js']) { require('child_process').execSync('node --check '+f, {stdio:'inherit'}); } console.log('verify OK')"
